articles.title: AI Coding 发展全景：从 Vibe Coding 到 Agentic Engineering
articles.deck: 从模型漂移、Vibe Coding 的争议到 Agentic 与 Harness Engineering：一份保留引文和参考链接的行业演进综述。
articles.title_en: The AI Coding Landscape: From Vibe Coding to Agentic Engineering
articles.deck_en: From model drift and the Vibe Coding controversy to Agentic and Harness Engineering: an industry evolution survey that keeps every citation and reference link.

articles.title: 对 co-arising 的启发：AI Coding 范式转移下的战略印证与工程路线
articles.deck: 把行业演进放回 co-arising 的语境，讨论确定性编译、业务切片、代码锚定与拟议工程路线；不是已交付能力清单。
articles.title_en: Implications for co-arising: Strategic Validation and an Engineering Route for the AI Coding Paradigm Shift
articles.deck_en: Placing the industry shift back into the co-arising context: deterministic compilation, business slicing, code anchoring and the proposed engineering route; not a list of delivered capabilities.

articles.title: 从「AI 垃圾」到月合并 11,000 PR：SpaceXSI 主任工程师 Lauren Tan 的 AI Coding 工程体系深度评估与落地指南
articles.deck: 以两场一手演讲与开源 pstack 为信源，对照 2024–2026 学术与工业实证检验「信任倒金字塔」与「验证优先」的适用边界，并给出四阶段落地路线。
articles.title_en: From "AI Slop" to 11,000 Merged PRs a Month: A Deep Evaluation and Adoption Guide of Lauren Tan's AI Coding Engineering System (Staff Engineer, SpaceXSI)
articles.deck_en: Grounded in two first-party talks and the open-source pstack, this evaluation tests the inverted trust pyramid and verification-first practice against 2024–2026 academic and industrial evidence, distilling a four-stage adoption route.

articles.title: AI Engineer CODE 2026 全部 50 场演讲相关性排序与全景拆解
articles.deck: 基于 50 份完整演讲字幕的零截断精读，按与确定性验证、Agent 工程治理等研究主航道的相关性排定 #01–#50 顺位，逐场拆解解决的问题、核心理论、验证成果与工具栈。
articles.title_en: AI Engineer CODE 2026: All 50 Talks Ranked by Relevance and Fully Unpacked
articles.deck_en: A zero-truncation close reading of all 50 complete talk transcripts, ranked #01–#50 by relevance to deterministic verification and agent governance — each unpacked across problem, core theory, validated results and toolchain.

articles.title: 规约本身就有 Bug：深度拆解 AWS Kiro 如何用 SMT 求解器在写代码前消灭 Spec 歧义与逻辑冲突
articles.deck: 深度解析 AWS Automated Reasoning Group 工程师 Rajath Kotyal 在 AI Engineer CODE 2026 的高分演讲《Specs have bugs too》：完整溯源 Slides 与学术引用，对比引入 SMT 前后的 Spec 写法与工作流，剖析 SAT/SMT 与多采样逻辑等价聚类原理，提供可直接运行的 SMT-LIB2 / Python Z3 样例与开源生态清单，并提出对 co-arising（truthsrc）实践的四大工程补充。
articles.title_en: Specs Have Bugs Too: How AWS Kiro Uses SMT Solvers to Eliminate Ambiguity and Logic Conflicts Before Writing Code
articles.deck_en: A technical deep dive into AWS Automated Reasoning Group engineer Rajath Kotyal's AI Engineer CODE 2026 talk 'Specs have bugs too': tracing slides and empirical citations, contrasting Before vs. After SMT specifications, demystifying SAT/SMT and multi-sample logical-equivalence clustering, sharing runnable SMT-LIB2 and Python Z3 snippets alongside open-source repositories, and proposing four architectural supplements for co-arising (truthsrc).

articles.title: co-arising EARS 1.0 技术规格说明书（v1.2 双语对照版）
articles.deck: 受控 EARS 唯一真源 + SMT-LIB 2 单跳确定性验证的完整语言规范：双语同构文法、bank-wealth-demo 四类实战样例、只读投影与 BDD 测试锁定，作为待落地的设计基准。
articles.title_en: co-arising EARS 1.0 Technical Specification (v1.2 Bilingual Edition)
articles.deck_en: The complete language specification for the controlled-EARS single truth source with single-hop deterministic SMT-LIB 2 verification: bilingual isomorphic grammar, four bank-wealth-demo worked examples, read-only projections and locked BDD tests — the design baseline pending implementation.
